$comment: Closed asset-role vocabulary. Every media / link / endpoint / font reference in a PageSpec is an assetRef {assetRole, source, ref?} whose assetRole must be a key here, whose source must be allowed by the role's generationPolicy, and whose ref must not contain any denylisted real-asset string. The source site is a real, live site by a real named author: its logo, 3D model, textures, meta images, author identity links and live endpoints must never be reused or imitated in generated output. Roles marked pinned:true are additionally checked against a hard-coded expected policy in schema/semantic_validate.py (PINNED_POLICIES), so a mutation to a different-but-valid policy is caught.

may-generate-new.meaning: A generator may create a new, original asset for this role.

must-not-reproduce.meaning: Real brand / real person / proprietary asset. Never reuse the original file or URL and never fabricate a look-alike. Use a clearly labelled neutral placeholder; the deployer supplies their own asset.

must-not-reuse-live-endpoint.meaning: A live third-party endpoint or tracking id. Never emit the real URL or id; emit a placeholder the deployer wires to their own backend.

license-required.meaning: Commercial or unverified-licence typeface. Do not ship or embed the font files; reference the fallback stack, or a font the deployer has licensed.

sources.placeholder: Neutral stand-in; ref, if given, must start with 'placeholder:'.
sources.generated: New original asset produced for the page; ref, if given, must start with 'generated:'.
sources.fallback-stack: Use the token fallback stack (Arial, sans-serif); no ref.
sources.licensed-by-deployer: A font the deployer licenses themselves; ref must start with 'licensed:'.

brand.logo-mark.description: The 'THE CODE FLOW. CO' logo SVG (nav right cluster, footer legal block).

icon.arrow.description: Small arrow glyph inside every pill CTA (14x14 viewBox, currentColor).

icon.discord.description: Discord glyph in the always-hidden community link. Third-party trademark.

webgl.cube-model.description: The Rubik's-cube GLB (3 layer meshes) rendered by the fixed WebGL layer.

webgl.matcap.description: The two matcap textures (body plastic / stickers) of the cube shader.

webgl.sticker-colormap.description: The sticker colour map revealed on CTA hover (+10%) and on solve.

identity.author-link.description: Links that identify the real author: personal site, Twitter redirect, privacy-policy Google Doc.

endpoint.form-action.description: Waitlist form submit target. The original posts to a live MailChimp list.

endpoint.analytics.description: Page analytics script / website id. The original loads Umami with a real website id.

font.commercial-sans.description: Helvetica Neue (400/700) and Helvetica Neue Condensed (700). Commercial typefaces.

font.mono.description: Firacode (400/700). No licence file present in the source project.

refDenylist.$comment: Case-insensitive substrings that must never appear in any assetRef.ref (any provenance). Real file names, hosts and ids from the original.

brandTextDenylist.$comment: Applied to ALL text of a PageSpec whose contentProvenance is 'generated' (case-insensitive; spaces and punctuation collapsed before matching). Real copy may appear only in an 'evidence-reference' PageSpec (the bundled example), which must never be published as the real brand.
